senses.gloss: m. (שפר; cmp. שׁוֹפָר 2, a. שְׁפוֹפֶרֶת) membraneous bag, sac of a fœtus; in gen. fœtus.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 3:3">Nidd. III, 3</cite> <he>המפלת ש׳ מלא וכ׳</he> if a woman discharges a sac full of water &c.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:3">Lev. R. s. 14</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:3:1">Y. Nidd. III, 50ᵈ</cite> top (ref. to <cite ref="Job 38:9">Job XXXVIII, 9</cite>) <he>לבושו זה הש׳ וכ׳</he> ‘its garment’ means the sac, ‘its swaddling band’, the placenta.
<cite ref="Job 38:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ מרוקם</he> a fœtus having an articulated shape, v. <cite ref="T01075"><he>רָשׁוֹן</he></cite>; Bab.
<cite ref="Niddah 25a:54">Nidd. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ שאינו מרוקם</he> a shapeless fœtus.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 7:2:3">Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵇ</cite> I have seen <he>עגל כאפון בש׳</he> the embryo of a calf, of the size of a bean, in a bag; a. fr.
